description.en: Adds a Resources tab to the right sidebar that shows live CPU, RAM, swap and disk usage of a Linux host, with rankings of the top processes, folders and files. Read-only, no dependencies; requires dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏新增“资源”页，实时显示 Linux 主机的 CPU、内存、交换区和磁盘用量，并列出占用最多的进程、文件夹和文件。只读、无依赖；需要 dsh-better-sidebar。
